name: Prismveil Tailvent Geneware Night Set
description: Designed explicitly for geneware-modded bodies, this Tier 3 club set from Prismveil's boutique gene-compatible line is one of the few mid-market options that takes tails, horns, and bioluminescent skin seriously as design elements rather than afterthoughts. The top is a draped halter constructed from iridescent sheer panels in overlapping layers of deep teal, bronze, and black — each panel is a different opacity, so the layering creates shifting depth as the wearer moves. The halter ties at the back of the neck with a long trailing ribbon that falls between shoulder blades, leaving the upper back entirely open for spinal rig access or wing-bud accommodation. The waistband is low and wide, sitting at the hips, constructed from semi-rigid holographic-trim synth-leather that catches light and throws prismatic scatter across nearby surfaces. Below: wide-leg trousers in flowing matte-black fabric with a deep rear pleat specifically tailored for tail accommodation — the pleat runs from waistband to hem with a hidden magnetic closure that lets the tail move freely while keeping the line of the trouser clean from the front. Horn rings — small chrome loops designed to clip onto genetic horn bases — come included, threaded with the same iridescent sheer as the top panels. Footwear is strappy heeled sandals in holographic synth-leather, with ankle wraps that coil up the calf. Bioluminescent skin shows dramatically through the sheer panels, turning the outfit into a living light display.
functionality: Open-back halter design accommodates spinal rigs and wing-buds. Rear-pleat trouser with magnetic closure designed for tail mobility. Horn rings clip to genetic horn bases. Sheer panel layering showcases bioluminescent skin. Holographic waistband scatters ambient light.
what_it_says: This wearer invested in being seen completely — not despite their geneware, but through it. The outfit is a frame for a modified body, treating genetic alterations as the luxury they actually are. Mid-tier professional money, spent on one excellent piece rather than several mediocre ones.
worn_by: tail and horn geneware carriers who are tired of off-the-rack accommodation
bioluminescent skin carriers who use their body as a canvas
boutique club regulars who know what fits their specific physiology
story_hooks: The magnetic tail-pleat closure uses a frequency that interferes with a specific model of surveillance drone — making the wearer inadvertently invisible to building security in certain club zones.
A Prismveil designer approaches the wearer mid-event, insisting this set was stolen from a client order — the wearer bought it legitimately, which means someone in the supply chain sold it twice.
The horn rings, clipped to genetic horn bases, start vibrating in a pattern the wearer recognizes as Morse — someone nearby has a transmitter tuned to that exact chrome alloy frequency.
